about: What doctor sends and how it reads the answers. page_request: the headers of the request doctor sends to a page of the user's website (site_url, or doctor --url): a page typed into a browser's address bar (Sec-Fetch-* as Chrome sends them for it), plus the three Web Bot Auth headers with values that only say they are a test; the site's middleware copies Sec-Fetch-* and Signature-Agent into its token and notes whether Signature and Signature-Input came, so doctor sees what reached the site's server. user_agent: {command}-doctor/{version}. blocked_errors: the errno names a connection to 127.0.0.1 fails with when a sandbox forbids it (macOS sandbox and Linux seccomp: EPERM or EACCES; a network namespace without loopback: ENETUNREACH), as opposed to ECONNREFUSED, which means nothing listens there. write_blocked_errors: the errno names a write in the replays folder fails with when a sandbox forbids it although the folder's permissions allow it (macOS sandbox: EPERM; Linux Landlock: EACCES), so doctor says so instead of calling the storage broken.
